cohort: 120 women presenting to Jinnah Hospital and Gulab Devi Hospital, Lahore, Pakistan with vaginal bleeding; 60 with placenta previa (cases) and 60 without (controls).
finding: Old maternal age, history of placenta previa, previous cesarean section, history of dilatation and curettage and evacuation of RPOCs, and miscarriages were significantly associated with placenta previa.
